patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Skin-colored, nontender, pearly papules with central umbilication on the abdomen and extremities

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Previously healthy, up-to-date immunizations, no significant illnesses.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Attends daycare three times per week.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No fever, rash in other locations, itching, or systemic symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the pediatric patient presenting with multiple skin lesions.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: My mom noticed small skin-colored bumps on my belly that don’t hurt or itch, and they look like little pearls with a tiny dent in the middle. They showed up after daycare, and I’ve also got a few on my arms and legs.

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what you're experiencing, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any loss of sight?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—no blurriness or dark spots. I’m mainly just getting these small, painless bumps on my belly, with a few on my arms and legs.

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t smoke, and I don’t have anyone around me who smokes that I know of.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any nausea or stomachaches—I feel fine otherwise, and the bumps are the only thing my mom has noticed.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any lumps or bumps around my chest or breast area—just the small, skin-colored bumps on my belly, with a few on my arms and legs.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can sometimes be linked to how we are feeling overall. Have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or emotional pressure lately?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t been feeling unusually stressed or upset lately. I’ve been acting like myself, and my only problem is the small, painless bumps my mom noticed on my belly, with a few on my arms and legs.

turns.doctor_question: To help me better understand your current symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, such as it appearing darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my urine color—it looks normal to me. I’m otherwise feeling fine, and it’s just those small, painless, skin-colored bumps on my belly with a few on my arms and legs.

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed this mass growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any bumps changing size or growing quickly—I’m just getting small skin-colored bumps that don’t hurt or itch. None of them have seemed to rapidly increase, and I feel otherwise fine.

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any pain in my wrists—my mom says I’m acting normal, and it’s only these small skin-colored bumps that don’t hurt or itch on my belly, with a few on my arms and legs.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what you're experiencing, could you please tell me if you have noticed any skin lesions, rashes, or unusual marks running along the veins of your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash that follows the veins on my arms, and the bumps are just small, skin-colored, and don’t hurt or itch on my belly, arms, or legs.”
